screen.text: Here are test cases for the first 4 endpoints from the Local Bookstore API scan. GET /api/books lists books and returns 200 OK. POST /api/books adds a book requiring title, author, isbn, price - test missing fields cause rejection. GET /api/books/{id} retrieves a single book - omit the ID to trigger 404. DELETE /api/books/{id} deletes a book - omit the ID to trigger 404. All cases use the documented success status and required fields from the parsed spec. Would you like test cases for the remaining 3 endpoints: orders listing, placing an order, and getting a specific order?
